title: E-CSM-0046: the tensor-ratio tension of the quadratic inflaton (E-CSM-0044, r about 0.14) is resolved by a plateau...
purpose: Experiment E-CSM-0046 in the cosmology arena: the tensor-ratio tension of the quadratic inflaton (E-CSM-0044, r about 0.14) is resolved by a plateau potential, which the exponential growth of the hyperbolic mesh naturally produces (constant-H de Sitter): the plateau gives $n_s$ about 0.965 matching Planck and r about 0.004 well below the 0.06 bound, so the tensor tension signals a plateau, the mesh-derived shape the remaining step.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
